headlines.headline: Lakers sale reportedly closes at NBA-record $12 billion valuation
headlines.detail: The richest sale price in North American pro sports history comes as the league opens its first full week of the 2026-27 season with Victor Wembanyama the odds-on MVP favorite.

headlines.headline: Vita Vea trade saga stays unresolved as Nov. 4 deadline nears
headlines.detail: The Rams are oddsmakers' favorite to land the two-time Pro Bowl DT, but Tampa Bay's coach and GM have both downplayed a deal; 49ers, Chargers, and Raiders are reported alternates.

headlines.headline: Unbeaten field narrows as Indiana preps for Ohio State amid CFP shuffle
headlines.detail: Miami (FL) and BYU are also still perfect as the defending national champion Hoosiers head into their toughest test yet at home against the Buckeyes.

headlines.headline: Florida opens No. 1 in AP preseason poll ahead of early-November tip-off
headlines.detail: The defending champion Gators got 47 of 59 first-place votes; Duke is No. 2, with tip-off roughly two weeks away.
